author: kilo-code-bot
body:
**WARNING:** "Same per-session lifecycle as the arming markers" overstates it — the markers' lifecycle includes `armSession`'s prune, which only sweeps the flat marker dir. The `hinted/` precedent this spec cites documents exactly this gap and closes it in code: "hinted/ sits below the dir armSession prunes, so stale markers need their own sweep" (`markSkillHinted` runs a same-TTL best-effort sweep on every write). The spec specifies no equivalent sweep for `trace/` and `fired/`, so a literal implementation of milestone .3 leaves one JSONL file per session (one line appended per post-tool event) accumulating forever in the shared `<git-common>/bro/hooks/` tree. Specify the prune — who sweeps the subdirs and on what TTL (e.g. the hinted-style same-TTL sweep on append, or a per-file size/age cap).

**SUGGESTION:** The trace is keyed per session (`trace/<session>.jsonl`), but nothing defines how the `sessionStart` probe discovers the previous session's id in order to read its "trace tail when resumable" — today's `HookInput` carries only `session_id`, and no resume/prior-session field exists in the hook payload. Milestone .3's implementer would have to invent a discovery rule; pin one here — e.g. the resume payload carries the prior session id, or fall back to the most recently modified trace file not belonging to this session, bounded by the marker TTL.

**SUGGESTION:** The schema types `on` as an Array ("at least one" event), but the CLI shows a single-valued `--on` with no repeatability marker — as written a lesson can only ever carry one event and the Array type is unreachable from `add`. Make it explicitly repeatable, matching the `--evidence <kind>:<ref>…` convention:

```suggestion
bro learn add --lesson "<rule>" --on <event>…
```

`<event>` ∈ `session-start|prompt-submit|post-tool`, repeatable to fill the trigger's `on` array.
